video_title: 'YOU'RE DAMN RIGHT IT IS!' 😳 - Perk says Game 4 is MUST-WIN for the Knicks | First Take

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins and Chris Russo debate if Game 4 is a must-win for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Whoever wins this game wins the series.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Whoever wins this game wins the series. If you're the Knicks, you're approaching this as if there's no tomorrow. Otherwise, winning two games on the road doesn't even matter. You want to bring your level of confidence back within your locker room, and you don't want to keep giving confidence to the San Antonio Spurs. You don't want to keep giving them hope. You want to come in, you want to smash the gas, and by the way, to the Knicks fan base, this is your time. No more excuses for throwing your best player down to the ground.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Russo
text_blocks.text: This is a much bigger game for San Antonio. San Antonio loses tonight, they're not winning the series. They're not going to beat the Knicks three in a row. I've said this for weeks: the Knicks, when they get to three and they have a game in their building to win a championship, they're not losing a game.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith explains why the Knicks are in trouble if they lose Game 4
quotes.excerpt: If the New York Knicks lose tonight, they're in a world of trouble.
quotes.quote: If the San Antonio Spurs lose tonight, but they win Game 5 back in San Antonio, then everything is about Tuesday night because you got the San Antonio Spurs needing to win one game to force a Game 7 back on their home turf. I look at the New York Knicks, if you win Game 1 and 2 on their home turf, you go on the road and then they snatch that momentum away from you in Games 3 and 4, I think that's a devastating blow to a less talented but more experienced New York team. To go on the road in Madison Square Garden with all the pomp and circumstance surrounding these two games and to snatch both games to reclaim home court advantage in an NBA Finals series with a bunch of 22-year-olds, I think that is devastating for the New York Knicks to overcome. If the New York Knicks lose tonight, they're in a world of trouble because all the momentum returns to San Antonio.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues the pressure is entirely on the Knicks for the rest of the series
quotes.excerpt: The pressure is all the way on the Knicks for the rest of the series.
quotes.quote: The pressure is all the way on the Knicks for the rest of the series. It's on the New York Knicks to close it out. When you look at what's at stake, you can't go on the road, you can't win close games and take home court advantage and come back to the quote-unquote Mecca and not get one. It can't happen. Right now, I could argue, well I'll say, the San Antonio Spurs, they're playing with house money all the way up to the end.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins predicts a Knicks win in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks are going to win this game tonight, Jalen Brunson is going to be outstanding.
quotes.quote: The Knicks are going to win this game tonight, Jalen Brunson is going to be outstanding. Mike Brown is going to make the adjustments he needs to make and Karl-Anthony Towns will be featured in the offense.

quotes.speaker: Chris Russo
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Russo predicts the Knicks will eke out a win in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: I think the Knicks will eke out a close game tonight and go up 3-1.
quotes.quote: I think the Knicks will eke out a close game tonight and go up 3-1.
